instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Change the rules that give back the storage of deleted files sooner than keep-for: by where it was, kind, size, days since deleted, or while storage is above a size", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:set-release-rules and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: rules replaces the whole list; each is { id, label, on, when, after_days, storage_above_bytes, order }.
4. It is given only these rows of the person's, read by the AI from the person's own store: setting (reads and makes); the rows it makes come back under keep, for the AI to keep there.
